description: This file implements utility functions for a simple UDP client object, including functions to get receive buffer, process incoming packets, and send packets over UDP, possibly using different socket modes.

methods.name: PVOID AnscScuoGetRecvBuffer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PULONG pulSize)
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer for incoming data if the object is active and a buffer exists.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscScuoRecv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Processes an incoming packet by updating internal state and delegating processing or discarding based on worker query.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscScuoSend(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Sends a packet over UDP to a previously configured peer address, supporting different socket modes.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscScuoSend2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulPeerAddr,USHORT usPeerPort,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Sends a packet over UDP to a specified peer address and port, supporting different socket modes.

ctags.name: AnscScuoSend2
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulPeerAddr,USHORT usPeerPort,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
